safeguard: retain a feasibility witness; validate outputs independently; test the validator with valid and invalid cases
failure: a negative result from an unsatisfiable instance; a solver and oracle sharing a semantic error

safeguard: pair configurations on instances and initial solver seeds; randomise and record execution order
failure: host drift or instance difficulty charged to a configuration
check: experiments/run.mjs (replicate seeds, seeded order, orderIndex in every row)

safeguard: use complementary work and wall-clock budgets; report budget-dependent conclusions
failure: an ablation sign set by the chosen budget
check: designs B-wall60, B-wall300, B-moves; analysis reports each budget

safeguard: include behaviourally null controls and periodic canary runs
failure: batch measurement error of unknown size
check: no-rcl arm in T3 designs; canaries in every wall-clock batch

safeguard: verify effective configuration values and diagnostic preconditions
failure: a silently changed parameter, ignored argument or undefined probe read
check: src/lib/solver.mjs effectiveOptions(); run.mjs rejects unknown arguments

safeguard: record metric, configuration, software, environment and seed provenance in every result row
failure: incomparable rows compared (metric, machine or version change)
check: run.mjs row fields: code hashes, metricVersion, env, seeds, options

safeguard: enforce analysis preconditions; report feasibility, missingness, exclusions and uncertainty
failure: a statistic computed on rows that violate its preconditions
check: analysis/analyse.mjs (complete cells, spent budgets, matched feasible pairs, 95 % CIs)

safeguard: generate tables and quantitative prose from stored measurements; verify deterministic reconstruction
failure: a number measured at build time or typed by hand
check: analysis/tables.mjs writes the LaTeX inputs; archive/reconstruct/*.mjs reproduce the historical figures
